description: A painted interior of a grand Renaissance-style hall with marble columns, frescoed walls and arched windows. A Japanese man in a gold-patterned brocade robe and dark armoured sleeves bows low with a katana at his waist, facing a seated pope in red and white on a raised throne at right. Kneeling figures in dark habits and gold garments sit at left, with cardinals in red, a Swiss Guard in striped uniform and a halberd, and other onlookers standing behind. No text, no frame, nothing graphic.
